parameters.content:
## JavaScript Page to Markdown
Render JavaScript-heavy pages in Chromium and get LLM-ready Markdown, with an optional screenshot. Use the cheaper url-to-markdown Actor when the text is already in the HTML.

Store page: https://apify.com/publicrecords/js-page-to-markdown
MCP: https://mcp.apify.com?tools=publicrecords/js-page-to-markdown

Edit the JSON body to change the input, then connect the output to Google Sheets, Slack, Airtable or email.
